metadata.title: AI Deforestation Satellite Training & Evaluation Dataset
metadata.summary: Unified multi-source satellite imagery dataset containing both authentic Sentinel-2 Google Earth Engine bi-temporal pairs and multi-spectral 4-band procedural scenes across 18 worldwide deforestation hotspots.

sources.name: Hugging Face JimmyBrocko/Forest-Change
sources.type: Real bi-temporal satellite imagery with human-annotated forest disturbance ground truth masks

sources.name: Sentinel-2 MSI Multi-Spectral Procedural Simulation
sources.type: 4-Band (Red, Green, Blue, NIR) calibrated reflectance for physical canopy modeling

sources.name: Global Forest Watch Curated Hotspot Presets
sources.type: 18 global deforestation frontline bi-temporal case studies with exact coordinates and real geospatial metrics

curated_presets.name: Amazon Basin (Rondônia, Brazil) - Road Corridor Logging
curated_presets.description: Systematic fishbone logging corridor expanding into primary rainforest.

curated_presets.name: Borneo Rainforest (Indonesia) - Palm Oil Clear-Cutting
curated_presets.description: Large-scale contiguous agricultural clear-cutting for oil palm plantation development.

curated_presets.name: Congo Basin - Selective Commercial Logging Pockets
curated_presets.description: Diffuse selective timber extraction creating canopy perforations.

curated_presets.name: Cerrado Savannah - Anthropogenic Wildfire & Burn Scar
curated_presets.description: High-intensity agricultural fire escape leaving extensive ash and char scar.

curated_presets.name: Western Ghats, India - Protected Intact Rainforest Reserve
curated_presets.site: Western Ghats UNESCO Reserve, Karnataka, India
curated_presets.description: Control baseline site: Dense, undisturbed evergreen canopy with zero deforestation.

curated_presets.name: Amazon Basin (Pará, Brazil) - Cattle Ranching & Pasture Conversion
curated_presets.description: Massive clearings for cattle ranching along the Trans-Amazonian Highway network.

curated_presets.name: Mato Grosso (Brazil) - Industrial Soy Frontier Expansion
curated_presets.description: Large rectangular geometric plots cleared for mechanized commercial grain agriculture.

curated_presets.name: Sumatra Peat Swamp Forest (Indonesia) - Drainage & Pulpwood Clearing
curated_presets.description: Canalized peat drainage concessions cleared for acacia pulp and oil palm cultivation.

curated_presets.name: Mai-Ndombe (DR Congo) - Smallholder Slash-and-Burn Mosaic
curated_presets.site: Mai-Ndombe Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo
curated_presets.description: Shifting subsistence cultivation mosaic with artisanal charcoal production clearings.

curated_presets.name: South Cameroon - Industrial Timber Concession Arterial Roads
curated_presets.site: Southern Cameroon Forest Concessions, Central Africa
curated_presets.description: Logging road network branching deep into previously unfragmented Guineo-Congolian forest.

curated_presets.name: Gran Chaco (Argentina/Paraguay) - Dry Forest Deforestation
curated_presets.site: Dry Chaco Ecoregion, Northern Argentina / Paraguay
curated_presets.description: Rapid bulldozer clearing of dry subtropical woodland for intensive beef production.

curated_presets.name: Madagascar Rainforests of the Atsinanana - Tavy Shifting Agriculture
curated_presets.description: High biodiversity montane slope clearing driven by traditional tavy slash-and-burn rice farming.

curated_presets.name: Sundarbans Biosphere Reserve (India/Bangladesh) - Coastal Mangrove Disturbance
curated_presets.description: Brackish mangrove shoreline recession, cyclone disturbance scars, and aquaculture encroachment.

curated_presets.name: Prey Lang Wildlife Sanctuary (Cambodia) - Illegal Timber Encroachment
curated_presets.site: Prey Lang Evergreen Lowland Forest, Northern Cambodia
curated_presets.description: Resin tree clearing and rubber plantation boundary incursions into protected evergreen forest.

curated_presets.name: Maya Biosphere Reserve (Petén, Guatemala) - Narco-Ranching & Encroachment
curated_presets.description: Rapid frontier pasture conversion and clandestine airstrip logging corridors in subtropical karst.

curated_presets.name: Athabasca Boreal Forest (Alberta, Canada) - Open-Pit Tar Sands & Seismic Lines
curated_presets.site: Athabasca Oil Sands Region, Boreal Plains, Alberta, Canada
curated_presets.description: Open-pit surface bitumen mining, tailing ponds, and grid-pattern seismic exploration lines.

curated_presets.name: Siberian Taiga (Sakha Republic, Russia) - Megafire Burn Perimeters
curated_presets.site: Central Yakutian Lowland, East Siberian Taiga, Russia
curated_presets.description: Climate-amplified boreal forest megafire burn perimeters consuming continuous larch taiga.

curated_presets.name: Gippsland & Blue Mountains (Australia) - Mega-Bushfire Crown Scorch
curated_presets.site: East Gippsland & Blue Mountains National Park, Australia
curated_presets.description: Catastrophic crown-fire burn scar across temperate dry eucalyptus forest canopy.
